title: AECOM’s (ACM) Record Backlog Collides With A Costly Charge

questions.question: Who pays the input, and who sells it?
questions.note: AECOM (ACM) pays the input cost (construction project charge), while AECOM sells the engineering/construction services to its clients (buyers).

questions.question: Is this capacity added or capacity destroyed?
questions.note: This is **capacity destroyed** due to the costly charge (delayed project completion) reducing AECOM’s operational capacity.

questions.question: Which listed substitute wins if the primary supply is missing?
questions.note: Substitutes (e.g., alternative construction firms like Bechtel or Fluor) win if AECOM’s supply is missing, per **A_AIR_02** (competitors gain market share).
